NJ-04.text: With Arbor Terrace counted the project needs about 30% of unmet demand at a 10% need rate (16% at 12%), above the 10–15% lender band; about 38% if Woodmont's approved Parsippany building goes ahead. NIC MAP pull and pre-leasing plan before LOI.

NJ-06.text: Whippany sits closer to the existing Whippany and Parsippany cluster and has a smaller 75+ base. With Arbor Terrace counted, unmet demand nearly disappears at a 10% need rate, so the pad does not support 114 units on its own. Hold it behind Florham Park; only one of the two should go forward.
